source_snapshot.criteria: Tool PASS, OS report within unspecified timeout, dmesg per AMD spec, and it may cause fatal conditions without data poisoning.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; operator injection with generic uncorrected/userspace/UE and SEL evidence.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Generic UCE logs cannot prove userspace victim identity, physical slot or expected fatal disposition.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds Data Poisoning and recovery gates but still lacks a PASS oracle for fatal versus contained behavior.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row 47 is CE userspace with process-survival intent; this UCE variant needs its own data-consumption and fatal-containment oracle rather than inheriting CE health criteria.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A criterion stated as `may` cannot determine PASS/FAIL for a destructive UCE; deterministic allowed outcomes and data-poison behavior are required.

original_test_intent: Validate userspace-targeted uncorrectable DRAM handling for each required slot, proving which application page was affected, whether poison is delivered or suppressed, and whether the resulting process/platform containment follows the approved policy.
original_method: Use a disposable process with a known-pattern buffer; map and pin a page to an approved DIMM target; define Data Poisoning Auto behavior and whether the page will be consumed; obtain an explicit outcome matrix for process signal/termination, machine check, reset/fatal state and no-poison path; inject one UCE under OOB observation; correlate exact page/location with MCA/APEI or WHEA and management evidence; recover, verify data and platform integrity, clean poison/allocation and restore state before any next target.
manual_activity: The FAE defines victim-page selection, poison consumption and accepted fatal/contained outcomes, executes one UCE under console control, owns recovery/cleanup and restores the complete RAS configuration.
required_inputs: Disposable victim process/buffer, access pattern and no-production-data guarantee
Pinned virtual/physical page to NUMA/UMC/channel/DIMM/slot map and tool binding
Data Poisoning Auto semantics for this mode and whether/when the victim consumes the poisoned line
Deterministic allowed outcome matrix for process, OS, machine check, reset/fatal state and boot recovery
DRAM-versus-MCA profile choice and tool/spec version/hash/license
Per-slot UCE evidence, timeout, persistent-poison cleanup, abort/OOB recovery and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated backed-up SUT with OOB console/power/reimage and disposable victim only
Do not inject until poison-delivery and fatal-outcome policy are explicit
One mapped UCE only; no automatic next-slot action after process/host disruption
Abort on wrong victim/slot, outcome outside matrix, uncontrolled reset, boot loop, lost console or persistent poison
Preserve offline evidence; no automatic retry/recovery; clean allocation/poison and restore BIOS/HDT/injector
agent_execution_scope: Validate victim/page/slot binding, poison policy, tool/profile provenance, outcome matrix and recovery
Collect read-only mapping, command, console, process, OS/BMC and post-recovery integrity evidence
Do not choose victim, consume poison, change BIOS/HDT, inject, reset/reimage/retry or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Replace `may` with an accepted outcome matrix and timing
Approve package/profile and supervised one-shot execution
Recover, clean poison, restore and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A generic uncorrected/userspace grep cannot prove victim attribution and may be unavailable if the host dies before flushing logs.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Bind one approved victim page/slot, run the literal userspace UCE once under continuous OOB capture and execute only the approved poison-access step, if any, to observe the deterministic disposition.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: errormode 1, injectonuserspace 1, mcapolling 0, errortype 1, Data Poisoning Auto, slots 1~N, optional fatal statement and 60/120 minutes are preserved; their missing semantics are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat one mapped userspace page as a destructive UCE checkpoint with a defined poison-consumption trigger, allowed containment matrix and OOB recovery proof.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds victim ownership, page binding, poison semantics, deterministic fatal/contained outcomes, offline evidence, cleanup and serialized slot approval.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool PASS plus optional fatal behavior cannot prove correct userspace UCE or slot 1~N coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Accessing an uncorrectable line can terminate the process, panic/reset the host or leave persistent poison; absent victim binding can affect unrelated data.

project_override_considerations: If the tool allocates and consumes its own userspace buffer, require it to report PID/page/physical target, payload integrity and poison action. `May result` must still be replaced by an approved outcome matrix for this platform configuration.
expected_evidence: Exact identity, profile/tool/spec and poison-policy approval
Victim PID/binary/hash, buffer pattern and page-to-slot mapping
Complete UCE and any approved consume-action transcript
Continuous OOB plus process signal/exit, MCA/APEI or WHEA and BMC/UEFI correlation
Observed outcome matched to deterministic matrix and bounded recovery
Poison/allocation cleanup, restored settings, post-health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Memory slot 1~N has no victim/page/UMC/slot selector. Criteria says fatal conditions without data poisoning only `may` occur, so neither fatal nor contained behavior determines PASS; Data Poisoning is Auto but its delivery/consume semantics are absent. Profiles conflict, timeout is undefined and Windows conflicts with dmesg.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The userspace UCE purpose is identifiable. Engineering can define victim binding, poison semantics and acceptable disposition, so static review completes while execution remains gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 48 Wistron-System RAS-00768-V002: define disposable victim buffer, page locking and page-to-slot/UMC binding for `injectonuserspace 1`; specify Data Poisoning Auto and approved consume action; replace `may result in fatal conditions without data poisoning` with deterministic process/MCA/reset/fatal/boot outcomes and timing; decide DRAM-versus-MCA profile; approve tool/spec provenance, per-slot Linux/Windows/BMC evidence, aborts, poison cleanup, OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Converts an optional fatal warning into a testable outcome matrix tied to a known userspace page, poison action and recoverable single-slot checkpoint.
independent_technical_reasoning: For a userspace UCE, injection and consumption can be separate events: poison may be recorded at injection, while process access triggers delivery and containment. Therefore `Data Poisoning Auto` and `may result in fatal` are insufficient to predict the DUT response. PASS requires a specified victim and permitted result such as a contained signal, logged machine check or bounded reset. Host logs may not flush during fatal handling, making OOB console and BMC/UEFI timestamps essential.
